events.body:
## Context

`test/` only covers `Task` and `TaskManager`. `lib/models/target.dart`, `lib/models/agent_result.dart` (with enum fallbacks), `lib/services/result_manager.dart` and `lib/services/target_manager.dart` are untested. Needs the Flutter SDK locally (CI skips Flutter today).

## What to do

1. Reuse the MockClient setup from `test/services/task_manager_test.dart`.
2. Add `test/models/target_test.dart`, `test/models/agent_result_test.dart` and `test/services/result_manager_test.dart`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] JSON round-trip and unknown-enum fallback tested
- [ ] ResultManager cache hit avoids a second HTTP call
- [ ] `flutter test` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-netguardian-client   # needs the Flutter SDK
```
